sample_unit: multiple-choice questions from 18 board exam clinical cases

links.outcome: GPT-4o accuracy on Spanish gastroenterology board exam clinical case questions and error analysis
links.effect: GPT-4o answered 39 of 49 questions correctly (79.6%); errors included unawareness of contraindications and inappropriate therapeutic generalizations.

links.outcome: Exam-style benchmark accuracy versus clinical reasoning quality
links.effect: 79.6% accuracy on board exam questions, yet reasoning errors showed omission of information already provided (clinical context, temporal criteria).
links.quote: the observed failures revealed that the model tends to omit information already provided (such as clinical context or temporal criteria), thereby compromising the quality of its reasoning.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and clinical reasoning errors of GPT-4o on Spanish gastroenterology board exam cases without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
